title: Hello
text: This website provides a toolkit for evaluating open data activity in an area and how to contribute to community efforts to improve local information. The list below provides examples of activity measures and action opportunities.

title: Hello
text:
Activity Measures

Events
Active civic technology and community organizations
Open data referenced in local news and blogs
Open data analysis products on local government and community organization websites
New and frequently updated datasets on open data portals

title: Hello
text:
Action Opportunities

Attend or volunteer at datathon and hackthon events
Attend meetings (council, community organizations, neighborhood associations)
Join civic technology organizations
Opportunities at local governments and community organizations
Public information requests for missing and incomplete data

title: About
text:
The intention of the Open Data Action Toolkit is to provide methods for measuring the activity of an open data community by including the work and events led by intermediaries and department data publishers. While data portal analysis provides some information about open data activity, the full picture of an open data ecosystem requires the inclusion of other modes of sharing information.
This toolkit is part of a dissertation portfolio that includes a case study of 3 local governments and a story map of open data policy analysis in the United States.
